facts.function: vacuum chamber housing and elliptical light collector of an EUV lithography scanner

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 8486 covers machines of a kind used solely or principally for manufacture of semiconductor devices, and parts and accessories
Section XVI note 2(b): parts suitable solely or principally for a particular kind of machine go with that machine; not excluded by section XVI note 1 or chapter 84 note 1

rejected_alternatives.reason: this is the complete machine; the goods are only components
collector is a part of a lithography machine, not a drawing or measuring instrument part

missing_facts: material of the parts (if a glass or optical element it could fall under chapter 90 or 70)
classification.rationale: Vacuum vessel housing and collector are dedicated parts of an EUV scanner used in semiconductor manufacture, classified as parts and accessories under heading 8486 via GRI 1 and section XVI note 2(b). No ruling precisely on point was found.
